scores.evidence: Phase 1a (schema, RBAC, Vault, registry hardening) before Phase 1b (multi-service, canary); "Depends on: Phase 1 complete; all V1–V3 gates passed."
scores.rationale: Substrate-to-upward ordering with gates proving dependencies, though minor inconsistencies (V4 spike and the engine choice after the skeleton already used a GitOps engine) weaken it slightly.

scores.evidence: "Git push to branch main of a test service → build triggered → artifact tagged and pushed → ... deployment to test K8s cluster → smoke tests → ... rollback"
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end commit-to-deploy-to-rollback slice with exit check V0, though on a test cluster rather than production.

scores.evidence: Table columns: "Default (chosen) | Assumption it rests on | Validated by | Flip condition" — e.g. "V4 fails → switch to imperative (Jenkins)"
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are listed with defaults, assumptions, validation and explicit flip conditions.

scores.evidence: "Schema and RBAC (widest impact) hardened in Phase 1a before multi-service pilots"; waves go 1 pilot → 10 → 20 → 15 → 5 critical
scores.rationale: Shared contracts and RBAC precede leaf work, and exposure is staged smallest first.

scores.evidence: "Image signed with a test key...; deploy verifies signature"; "RBAC in place: test service account can only deploy to test namespace"
scores.rationale: Concrete security controls appear in Phase 0, 1, 2 and 3.

scores.evidence: "All pipeline steps emit structured logs (JSON...) → ELK. Metrics: Build time... Alerts: Any step failure → Slack / PagerDuty"
scores.rationale: Observability is built into Phase 0 and extended concretely in every later phase.

scores.evidence: "Dockerfile is pinned (base image digest, not 'latest'); all deps frozen... Repeating the skeleton 2 hours later: same build artifact hash"
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is tested in Phase 0 and carried through IaC, V1 gate, lineage tracing and DR replay.

scores.evidence: "pipeline retries 3 times with exponential backoff"; Phase 1 circuit breaker/queue when registry down; Phase 2 auto-rollback and incident playbook
scores.rationale: Failure handling has concrete content in every phase starting with Phase 0.

scores.evidence: "N/A — no AI component. Platform is deterministic orchestration; no model, no learning, no prompt injection"
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.
